newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Irondequiot, N.Y..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Irondequiot, N.Y..

text.p: Sealed proposals will be received and considered by the Supervisor of the Town of Irondequoit, Monroe County, New York, at the Offices of Willkie Farr & Gallagher, 900 Third Avenue, Conference Room 17-B, New York, New York 10022, at 11:00 o'clock A.M., Prevailing Time, on the

at which time and place the bids will be opened, for the purchase INFEDERALFUNDS at not less than par and accrued interest of $3,900,000 Public Improvement (Serial) Bonds, 1997, of said Town, dated August 1, 1997, with interest thereon payable on August 1, 1998 and semi-annually
thereafter on February 1 and August 1, and maturing August 1 as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

THE TOWN RESERVES THE RIGHT TO CHANGE THE TIME AND/OR DATE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS. NOTICE OF ANY SUCH CHANGE SHALL BE PROVIDED NOT LESS THAN 24 HOURS PRIOR TO THE TIME SET FORTH ABOVE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS BY MEANS OF A SUPPLEMENTAL NOTICE OF SALE TO BE TRANSMITTED OVER THE THOMSON MUNICIPAL NEWS (FORMERLY KNOWN AS MUNIFACTS WIRE).

Each bid, accompanied by a $78,000 good faith check, must be for all of said $3,900,000 bonds. Award will be made based on net interest cost. The purchaser will be furnished without cost, the unqualified legal opinion as to the validity of the Bonds of Willkie Farr & Gallagher, New York, New York, Bond Counsel.

Bidders must refer to the complete Notice of Bond Sale for the terms and conditions of the sale. To obtain copies of the complete Notice of Bond Sale, Bid Form, and the Official Statement of the Town, please contact Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc., telephone (315) 699-7912, telecopier: (315) 699-8833. Additional Official Statement may be downloaded from Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc.'s Internet address: http://www.fiscaladvisors.com.
Dated: Irondequoit, New York, William S. Dillo
